### What changes / 무엇이 바뀌나요 / 何が変わりますか / 改动内容

### Why / 이유 / 理由 / 原因

### How it was tested / 확인한 방법 / 確認方法 / 测试方式

### Checklist / 확인 목록 / チェックリスト / 检查清单

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run test:unit` pass (and `npm run test:web` for web changes)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change in behaviour
- [ ] Every new user-facing string is in `en`, `ko`, `ja` and `zh`
- [ ] Docs updated in all four READMEs and `.env.example` where it applies
- [ ] No real addresses, domains, accounts, keys, tokens or copyrighted files
